title: Customer Sentiment Analysis
description: Streamlit app that analyzes customer reviews to predict sentiment, complaint registration, and issue resolution using TF-IDF/NLP and a 6-algorithm ML comparison (Logistic Regression, KNN, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost).
tools: Python, scikit-learn, pandas, numpy, NLTK/TF-IDF, Plotly

title: Dynamic Pricing: Ride Cost Prediction
description: Streamlit app that estimates ride fares using regression modeling, with ride duration and vehicle type as the key cost drivers.

title: HR Employee Attrition Prediction
description: Streamlit app predicting employee attrition risk using a 6-algorithm ML comparison, with interactive Plotly dataset insights and ROC curve analysis.

title: Loan Approval Prediction
description: Streamlit app predicting loan approval outcomes using a 6-algorithm ML comparison (best model: Random Forest, ROC-AUC ~0.99), with credit score as the strongest predictor.

title: Telco Customer Churn Prediction
description: Streamlit app predicting customer churn using a 6-algorithm ML comparison (deployed model: Random Forest, ROC-AUC ~0.84), with tenure and contract type as the strongest churn signals.

title: Housing Price Prediction

tools: Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, Streamlit
